en.cv.summary: 2nd-year Computer Science and Engineering student at Instituto Superior Técnico, driven by solving problems across the entire software stack. Building on a solid foundation in C, Java and Python, with a strong focus on systems programming and software architecture.
en.cv.summary2: Looking for a summer internship to build functional and scalable software.

en.cv.p1.title: Express Retail Platform (ERP) (Ongoing)
en.cv.p1.b1: Building an object-oriented command-line retail management system featuring dynamic order splitting, inventory tracking and state serialization.
en.cv.p1.b2: Designing a highly extensible architecture following the Open-Closed Principle.
en.cv.p2.title: CloudIST VM Simulator (Ongoing)
en.cv.p2.b1: Developing a data center simulator in C to manage virtual machine allocation and concurrent request processing.
en.cv.p2.b2: Implementing multithreading, process isolation (fork, exec), and strict resource limitations (CPU/Memory) via POSIX system calls.
en.cv.p3.title: Invoicing & Inventory CLI
en.cv.p3.b1: Built a stock-management system in C featuring a product catalogue, shopping cart, and invoice history.
en.cv.p3.b2: Implemented a custom merge sort, EAN checksum validation, and a wildcard search engine.
en.cv.p4.title: Scrabble Game & Agent
en.cv.p4.b1: Built a full Scrabble engine in Python for human and bot players across three difficulty levels.
en.cv.p4.b2: Implemented board/move validation, a custom xorshift shuffle algorithm, and a move-search AI agent.
en.cv.p5.title: My portfolio & CV
en.cv.p5.b1: Developed a custom, responsive single-page portfolio and interactive CV.
en.cv.p5.b2: Designed a clean UI featuring seamless dark mode integration and a print-optimized layout.
